text:
kai: Heads-up from PM: leadership asked for a narrow MVP to meet the compliance pilot timeline. Draft call: keep hosted API, hosted-only embedding cache, local KMS integration (customer-managed keys) in MVP; push region-based data residency and org-level SSO to v1. Also include email 2FA only. Quick takes? :small_blue_diamond:

toni: Agree with pushing region residency to v1. Splitting that work saves infra + legal cycles. Important: local KMS for MVP is non-negotiable for the pilot.

ben: Engineering note: hosted-only emb-cache + KMS adds ~6 dev days, region residency adds ~4 weeks because of data routing and audit requirements. Recommend scoped cache to avoid per-region routing.

marie: Sales: Our pilot customer in APAC will accept scoped MVP if we offer a signed pilot addendum. Need comms that call out feature limitations and expected timeline to v1. I'll draft the addendum. :memo:

kai: Good. We also need a launch contingency: if public latency p95 > 420ms or error rate > 1.5% during canary, we fall back to quantized model and disable cache writes. Any objections?

toni: Sounds sensible. Add a quality-monitoring check for embedding recall drop (>8%) so product/data get alerted.

ben: I'll add the fallback and a kill-switch. Draft rollout snippet for the milestone doc:

```json
{
  "canary_duration_minutes": "45",
  "failure_conditions": "p95>420ms || error_rate>0.015 || embed_recall_drop>0.08",
  "fallback_behavior": "switch-to-quantized-no-cache",
  "kill_switch": "feature-flag:mvp_embcache_off"
}
```

release-bot: Canary provisioned: canary-apac-pilot-3223. URL: https://canary.redwood/internal/canary-apac-pilot-3223 :rocket:

marie: I'll coordinate the addendum and post the comms draft into PROD-1122 by EOD. Also need a short FAQ for the pilot customer about limitations.

kai: Owners: Marie -> customer addendum + comms; Ben -> rollout + kill-switch + infra checklist; Toni -> security/KMS validation and audit checklist. I'll update milestone tracker to reflect the scope decision (MVP: hosted api, emb-cache-hosted, local-KMS, email-2fa; v1: region-residency, org-SSO, SMS/TOTP).

ben: One more ask: tag SRE for a load-profile run in canary. We should validate p95 with production-like traffic.

toni: I'll schedule SRE run. Also will prepare an audit diff doc to show what v1 adds vs MVP for legal.

marie: Sales note: offer pilot customer an opt-in window and explicit SLA caveat if we enable quantized fallback. I'll include pricing impact in the addendum.

release-bot: Milestone updated: https://redwood/issue/PROD-1122. Field changes: mvp_scope="hosted-api,hosted-embcache,local-kms,email-2fa"; v1_scope="region-residency,org-sso,sms-totp".

kai: If no objections by EOD I'll lock scope and start stakeholder comms. Please react or raise concerns now.

ben: No objections from eng. Starting implementation ticket PRs.

marie: No objections from sales. Draft will be in the ticket.

toni: No objections from security. Scheduling audit review.

kai: Locking scope at 18:00 PT unless anything else surfaces. Thanks team. :lock:
